messages:
maria (Finance): Heads up — AWS Marketplace auto-renewal for reseller partner CloudBridge caused an overlap: seats were active on both the old offer (offer-oz) and the new offer (offer-ny) for 7 days. Looks like double usage charged to the partner. Invoice AWS-INV-54821 shows a duplicate line for Mar usage. Need an adjustment / credit memo before month-end close. Estimated overcharge ~ USD 12,400. @ajay @lisa tagging for partner context.
ajay (Sales): Confirmed renewal was initiated by partner on 2026-03-10; they migrated to new offer id 98765. They believed migration would deprovision the old offer immediately. cc @sam who handled the transition.
lisa (Partner Ops): We observed duplicate mapping rows in the reseller mapping table for customer cb-001. Partner ops can share the migration request and signed confirmation. @billing-bot can you pull usage lines for account cb-001 for Mar 1-15?
billing-bot: Query complete. Found 7 overlapping days. Lines: invoice_line_ids [AL-1001, AL-1002]. Estimated double-billed tokens: 1,240,000. Estimated USD: 12,400. Created internal ticket FIN-3589.
maria (Finance): Thanks. We need a formal credit memo request to AWS Marketplace settlement team. @ryan can you prepare the credit memo draft and GL mapping? We need GL codes and approval.
ryan (RevOps): I'll draft. Need the partner's billing contact and the signed migration note to attach. Lisa, can you upload the migration confirmation here?
lisa (Partner Ops): Uploading migration email thread now — link: https://redwood.internal/drive/links/migration-cb-001. Attachment contains partner request with timestamp and partner-confirmed deprovision plan.
sam (Account Exec): FYI partner is asking for expedited handling; they have a finance close next week. They also requested pro-rated refunds to end-customers. Do we pass-through credits to partner or issue settlement adjustments? @ajay
ajay (Sales): We normally issue a settlement adjustment to the partner and they handle pass-through to their customers. If they want us to push credits to end-customers via AWS that requires publisher-level flows and is slower. Recommend settlement adjustment + credit memo to partner. CC finance approval.
maria (Finance): OK proceed with settlement adjustment to partner. Ryan please include: reason = "offer renewal overlap — duplicate marketplace seats", amount = "USD 12,400", invoice ref = "AWS-INV-54821", GL = "4210" (Marketplace rebates). Approval needed from finance lead.
ryan (RevOps): Draft ready, posting for approval. Here's the credit memo text:

``
Credit memo to CloudBridge (partner id CB-001)
Amount: USD 12,400
Reason: Duplicate charge due to overlapping offers during AWS Marketplace renewal 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-16
Related invoice: AWS-INV-54821
GL code: 4210
``

Approvers: @maria, @cecilia (Finance Lead).
cecilia (Finance Lead): Approved. Please route to AWS settlement operations and include FIN-3589 ticket. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Credit memo request sent to AWS Marketplace team: ticket AWS-SETTLE-9123. ETA 7-10 business days. Slack thread updated.
maria (Finance): Excellent. I'll log the adjustment in the month-end workbook and flag it in close notes. Thanks team.
lisa (Partner Ops): :thumbsup:
